writeup: Certified International's Holiday Magic Gnomes canape plates (model 37333SET4) are a set of four six-inch earthenware plates with Susan Winget's gnome art. Woot has the set new for $14.99, while Home Depot charges $25.12 and Kohl's $38.39 even with a code, so you save about $10. Woot limits it to 3 per order.
